items.title: 3 Dividend Stocks With Yield Over 2%
items.summary: Fed officials now flag artificial intelligence as the biggest single risk to the financial system, with complex AI financing and elevated valuations under scrutiny. That focus puts a premium on companies that return cash to shareholders in a measured, repeatable way. Growing dividend payers yielding roughly 2% to 5% can offer a middle ground between income and reinvestment. This article highlights three such stocks that fit this steady compounding profile. items.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Plans 1,000 North America Job Cuts In Elliott Backed Turnaround
items.summary: PepsiCo (NasdaqGS:PEP) plans to cut about 1,000 jobs across its North American units as part of a turnaround effort. The layoffs follow pressure from activist investor Elliott Investment Management, which has been pushing for sharper cost and productivity measures. Management is tying the workforce reduction to efforts to address sluggish North American sales and to refocus operations on efficiency.
